rationale: The stock opened at its high ($16.03) and sold all morning to -5.4% versus SPY's -0.33% on 5.4x relative volume — clear relative weakness with no news to fuel a reversal. The midday bounce has stalled exactly at the declining 9-EMA/VWAP pivot ($15.56-15.57), with the largest of the last five 1-minute prints closing on a down-tick, consistent with supply pressing a bear flag rather than buyers building a base. Shorting this failed rally with risk defined above the consolidation high (~$0.12, about 1.5 five-minute ATRs) targeting a retest of the $15.29 session low gives roughly 2:1 reward-to-risk; size kept modest at 10% of buying power given only $465 of daily loss budget remains.
